_doc: Golden ticket set for AI Reviewer regression evaluation. Each entry is a closed ticket whose 'expected' answers represent the human-judged ground truth for the audit form. Set 'expected' to null until a human has graded the ticket — runEval skips ungraded records (reports them as 'unscored') instead of failing. The four gradeable question_ids on form 99016 are 99125-99128 (all YES_NO).
